title: The cut-off radial operator ω ↦ ζ·Kω: a linear map 𝒟^{q+2}(ℝ^P) → 𝒟^{q+1}(ℝ^P) that equals Kω on ball(0, ρ), with ‖ζ·Kω‖ ≤ (ρ+1)·sup‖ω‖
statement:
Let P, q ∈ ℕ and ρ > 0. For a (q+2)-form β on ℝ^P (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q+1+1)) put
 (Kβ)(x) := ∫_0^1 t^{q+1}·ι_x(β(t x)) dt,
where ι_xα := α.curryLeft x, i.e. (ι_xα)(v_1, …, v_{q+1}) = α(x, v_1, …, v_{q+1}).
Assume (H): for every C^∞ (q+2)-form β (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β: smoothness order ∞, not analytic), the (q+1)-form Kβ is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)).
Then there is an ℝ-linear map Φ : 𝒟^{q+2}(ℝ^P) → 𝒟^{q+1}(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ (q+1+1) →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn univ (q+1)) such that:
(i) (Φω)(x) = (Kω)(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{q+2}(ℝ^P) and every x with ‖x‖ < ρ;
(ii) if b ∈ ℝ and ‖ω(y)‖ ≤ b for every y ∈ ℝ^P (operator norm on covectors), then ‖(Φω)(x)‖ ≤ (ρ+1)·b for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
(H) is the smoothness half of dimred_cs_sos_cfs_radial_homotopy at degree q+1. The selected node discharges it when it assembles its children.
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → (∀ β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1 + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • (β (t • x)).curryLeft x)) → ∃ Φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1 + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1 + 1)) (x : Euclid P), ‖x‖ < ρ → (Φ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)) x = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1 + 1)) (t • x)).curryLeft x) ∧ ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1 + 1)) (b : ℝ), (∀ y, ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1 + 1)) y‖ ≤ b) → ∀ x, ‖(Φ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)) x‖ ≤ (ρ + 1) * b
